name: Gust of Wind
summary: A 60-ft-long, 10-ft-wide Line of wind pushes creatures 15 ft away (Str save) and slows movement toward you.
text: A Line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the duration. Each creature in the Line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you along the Line, and a creature that ends its turn in the Line must make the same save. Any creature in the Line spends 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves closer to you. The wind disperses gas and vapor and puts out candles and similar unprotected flames in the area; protected flames such as lanterns flicker wildly and have a 50 percent chance to go out. As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can change the Line's direction.
